description: The file defines a Java class MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. It serves as a filter that only passes log messages, omitting other metadata, suitable for on-screen log display. The class supports chaining via a next LogNode.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter LogNode that passes only log messages, omitting metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode to chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message part when forwarding to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
